name: comp-21
title: Input With End Button
blurb: Email input with a Send text button on the right.
description: An email input field with an inline 'Send' button on the right. Button has background, border, padding, and hover states.
use_when: A compact email form where the button text 'Send' immediately signals the action.
avoid_when: You need icon-only buttons or the button needs to be narrower.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button is text-labeled (no aria-label needed). Focus management via z-index. Disabled state supported.
